method: Native simple visibility collision, 1 m travel stations and 0.25 m crossing stations. Grade uses travelled horizontal arc distance, not the chord across intervening route bends. Overlapping station sets create short intervals: intervals under 0.20 m retained in raw diagnostics, excluded from acceptance to avoid millimetre ray-query error amplification. Analytical 0.25 m inventory independently samples every polyline segment, including its vertices. This is sampled qualification, not a continuous-grade or turning-radius guarantee.
